'''Justin Roth''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Rochester tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|goofy Hunt Down]], according to R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1686">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ rochester-ny-1-27], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 29 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-rochester-ny-1-27d1686/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Card credits ==
Justin Roth is credited with the original concept of two Players Committee [[Virtual cards]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The concept credit names where the concept was won: [[2005 New York State Championship|New York States 2005]]. The cards are in [[Virtual Block 4]] (cards first released 2002–2009) and [[Virtual Set 0]] (released 24 September 2014).

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Card !! Set !! Released !! Credit as printed
|-
| [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber|•Mara Jade With Lightsaber]] || [[Virtual Set 0]] || 24 September 2014 || "Original concept by Justin Roth"
|-
| [[Mara Jade With Lightsaber (Virtual Block 4)|•Mara Jade With Lightsaber]] || [[Virtual Block 4]] || 2002–2009 || "Original concept by Justin Roth, New York States 2005"
|}

The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Justin Roth|Justin Roth]] on [[Card Credits]].
